name: Benchmark | Huntsville, Alabama
old_description: Located in the innovative heart of Rocket City, U.S.A., Benchmark Huntsville embodies a legacy of excellence in advanced manufacturing for aerospace, defense, computing, and bioscience that
about:
Benchmark’s Huntsville operation sits in the heart of Alabama’s Rocket City The site traces its manufacturing lineage to 1963, when the facility began serving the region’s emerging aerospace and defense sectors. Today it operates as part of Benchmark Electronics, a global contract manufacturer, with John Russell serving as general manager.

The plant provides end-to-end electronics manufacturing and engineering services. Its advanced manufacturing floor handles mechanical and precision machining, microelectronics, mixed and hybrid assembly, PCB assembly and surface-mount technology, and full system build and integration. Engineering teams deliver electrical, mechanical, and microwave/millimeter-wave design, software development, test development, and design-for-excellence support. The site also runs automation solutions, environmental stress screening, and mmWave test capabilities, backed by lifecycle management services including depot repair, sustaining engineering, and supply chain management.

Customers span commercial aerospace, defense, advanced computing, medical technologies, industrial, next-gen communications, and semiconductor capital equipment. The Huntsville team has built UAV communications modules and flight computers for FAA-regulated programs, scaled high-volume lidar sensor production for Ouster, delivered AI-enabled mobile surveillance systems for U.S. Customs and Border Protection, and manufactured components for Intel’s Aurora exascale supercomputer and HPE’s AI infrastructure. Other projects include autonomous mobile robot redesigns, satellite communication terminal transfers, and cryogenic kiosks for stem cell therapy.

Benchmark emphasizes its Buy American and TAA-compliant solutions, a workforce with an average 15-year tenure, and close collaboration with the company’s Minnesota and Santa Ana design centers. The site maintains ITAR registration and AS9100 certification to meet defense and aerospace requirements.

name: Bend Battery
old_description: Bend Battery LLC is a leading provider of off-grid power solutions, specializing in Lithium
about:
Bend Battery LLC operates from Bend, Oregon, supplying off-grid power components and installation services for mobile and stationary applications. The company's founding date and ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The business designs and installs complete energy storage systems centered on lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO4) batteries, solar arrays, inverters, and charge controllers. It stocks and sells equipment from brands such as Victron Energy, Blue Sea Systems, Furrion, and Dicor, covering solar charge controllers, inverter/chargers, battery monitors, disconnect switches, and roof sealants. The team provides technical consulting to size systems for RVs, vans, trailers, boats, and off-grid homes, and performs the installation work themselves rather than subcontracting.

Customers include RV owners upgrading factory electrical systems, van-life builders, trailer owners, marine operators, and off-grid homeowners. Reviews cite projects like a 28-day off-grid trip in an Arctic Fox 27-5L trailer and ongoing supply for Channel Islands Charter, indicating both one-off upgrades and repeat commercial accounts.

Bend Battery emphasizes guided system design and post-sale support, with a policy of installing only systems they have specified. The company highlights a bundle builder that discounts multi-item orders and free shipping on orders over $49.99, positioning itself as a single source for both hardware and expertise.

name: Bently Nevada
about:
Bently Nevada operates from Minden, Nevada, as a division of Baker Hughes. The business traces its roots back more than six decades, building a reputation in machinery monitoring and protection.

The company designs and manufactures a comprehensive portfolio of asset performance management solutions. Its product lines include the 3500 Machinery Protection System, Orbit 60 Series, ADAPT Overspeed/ESD protection, SCOUT200 and ADRE portable vibration analyzers, and System 1 software for condition monitoring and analytic insights. Sensor offerings cover acceleration, velocity, proximity, pressure, hydro, and wireless models, with millions of units installed worldwide and thousands of monitoring systems deployed across a global support network.

Bently Nevada serves asset-intensive industries such as oil and gas (including refining, offshore production, petrochemical, LNG, and fertilizer plants), power generation (coal, combined cycle, wind, hydro), mining, discrete manufacturing, food and beverage, steel and metal, pulp and paper, sugar production, and wastewater. Customers rely on its technologies for turbomachinery, compressors, pumps, motors, gearboxes, and heavy industrial equipment.

The company emphasizes its 60-plus years of machinery expertise, a global services network, and the integration of hardware, software, and diagnostic services through its Cordant Devices platform to connect machine health insights with enterprise workflows.

name: Berlin Packaging
old_description: Shop wholesale bottles, jars, cans, drums, and more – containers to suit every industry.
about:
Headquartered in Brooklyn Park, Minnesota, Berlin Packaging operates as a hybrid container and packaging supplier that combines distribution, manufacturing partnerships, and value-added services. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure in public materials.

Berlin Packaging supplies plastic, glass, and metal containers, closures, and dispensing systems sourced from a network of over 900 manufacturers worldwide, with the majority of products made in the United States. The company maintains 100-plus sales and warehouse locations across the globe, encompassing more than 6 million square feet of warehousing space, and carries over 50,000 SKUs. Its service portfolio includes package design and engineering through the Studio One Eleven studio, global sourcing, quality management with an in-house testing lab, fluorination and UV coating, custom decorating and labeling, supply chain management, inventory warehousing, and management consulting via its E3 division. The company employs more than 2,200 people.

The supplier serves a broad range of end markets, including food, beverage, spirits, wine, beer, personal healthcare and beauty, pharmaceutical and nutraceutical, home care, pet care and veterinary, industrial chemical, automotive, and cannabis and CBD.

Berlin Packaging positions its hybrid model as a differentiator, offering services such as design, sourcing, and consulting at no direct charge in exchange for packaging supply agreements. The company states its mission is to improve customers' net income by increasing sales, reducing costs, and improving productivity through packaging solutions.

name: Bernhard Woodwork Ltd.
old_description: Manufacturers of Fine Custom Architectural Woodwork: From Start to Finish
about:
Bernhard Woodwork Ltd. has operated from Northbrook, Illinois since 1965, when the company transplanted European cabinetmaking traditions to the Chicago area. The business was founded on the premise that architectural woodwork requires both old-world craft and modern precision, a philosophy that continues to guide its work today.

The firm produces custom architectural woodwork for commercial, retail, residential, and marine projects. Its craftsmen handle veneer matching, joinery, and finishing with lacquers, enamels, and oils, while also incorporating advanced manufacturing technologies to improve quality and speed. The shop serves as a single source from design collaboration through final installation, though facility size and headcount are not publicly disclosed.

Bernhard Woodwork’s client base includes architects, designers, and planners across the United States. The company has completed hundreds of commercial and retail projects for major national brands, as well as high-end residential and marine interiors. A testimonial from Dirk Denison Architects highlights the firm’s attention to detail and proactive problem-solving on complex installations.

The company distinguishes itself through a European-style apprenticeship program that cultivates long-tenured craftspeople—average tenure is 14 years—and a commitment to preserving the integrity of each architectural concept. By blending time-honored techniques with contemporary equipment, Bernhard Woodwork aims to deliver environments where form and function meet without compromise.

name: Best Buy
old_description: How do I check product availability at the Midtown Manhattan (44th And 5th) Best Buy?
about:
Best Buy operates a Midtown Manhattan location in New York City. The store functions as a full-line electronics and appliance retailer with dedicated specialty shops and an on-site Geek Squad service center. No founding year or ownership details are disclosed for this specific location.

The location stocks computers, tablets, televisions, home theater systems, video games, cell phones, audio equipment, appliances, smart home devices, cameras, wearables, health and personal care items, home office furniture, and toys. It hosts branded experience areas including an Apple Shop, Samsung Experience Shop, Windows Store, and Camera Experience Shop. Geek Squad provides repair, installation, and technical support services for products purchased at the store or elsewhere. The store also offers open-box inventory at reduced prices.

The store serves consumer shoppers in the New York metropolitan area seeking electronics, appliances, and related services. Customers include individuals purchasing for personal use, as well as small businesses acquiring technology equipment. The Apple Authorized Service Provider designation allows the location to perform warranty and out-of-warranty repairs on Apple devices.

The company emphasizes convenient service options such as in-store Geek Squad support, curbside pickup, and scheduled installation appointments. Specialty shops create brand-specific environments for product exploration, while open-box offerings provide cost savings on returned or refurbished items.

about:
BiTech Medical is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. The company focuses on delivering custom medical device manufacturing, equipment maintenance, healthcare IT integration, and specialized training services to healthcare providers nationwide.

Its core operations span custom device design and production tailored to clinical requirements, nationwide onsite equipment repair and maintenance with a typical turnaround of one to two weeks, advanced IT integration including electronic medical record implementation, cybersecurity, and data analytics, and hands-on training for medical staff covering operating procedures, safety norms, and troubleshooting.

BiTech Medical serves healthcare facilities such as hospitals and clinics, supporting a range of equipment including diagnostic imaging systems, therapeutic devices, and patient monitoring systems. Its IT solutions are designed to integrate with existing healthcare infrastructure, and its training programs are tailored to specific equipment and facility needs. The company also provides after-sale support including technical assistance, updates, and periodic maintenance checks.

The company differentiates itself through a combination of manufacturing expertise, rapid repair turnaround, and comprehensive after-sale support. Its stated mission is to empower healthcare with cutting-edge technologies and unmatched support services, emphasizing quality and compliance in every device manufactured.

name: Big Picture Foods
old_description: Free Shipping on orders over $75. All packages ship on Monday & Tuesday.
about:
Big Picture Foods operates from Barrington, Rhode Island, producing a line of artisan specialty foods centered on regeneratively farmed organic olives. The company emphasizes small-batch craft production, with olives that are sun-ripened and hand-picked at peak perfection before undergoing a natural fermentation process.

The product range includes several olive varieties—such as Greek Mix, Green Amfissa, and Double Stuffed Garlic & Jalapeño—alongside wild foraged capers, extra virgin olive oil, and jarred banana and red peppers. All items are slow-cured using natural fermentation, which the company says preserves nutrients and yields gut-friendly probiotics. Every product contains only four ingredients and no additives or preservatives.

Big Picture Foods sells through a growing network of retail partners across the United States, directing consumers to a store locator on its website. The brand targets shoppers seeking raw, antioxidant-rich pantry staples that support digestive health and anti-inflammatory benefits, positioning itself as an alternative to chemically cured, mass-produced equivalents.

The company frames its mission around regenerative agriculture, stating that its groves withdrew 20 tons of carbon from the atmosphere last year compared with seven tons added by conventional methods. It describes this climate impact as core to its "different bottom line," linking soil health directly to the flavor and nutritional profile of its fermented foods.

Billy Warren & Son is a family-owned-and-operated business founded in 1978 in Greenwood, Delaware. The company has served customers in the region for over four decades, building a reputation as a local hardware supplier and metal service provider.

The firm operates as a hardware supplier and provides roll-off container service for scrap metal. Its product range includes industrial hardware, new metal, and surplus metal, with inventory that changes regularly. The company does not disclose facility size, headcount, or production volumes.

The business primarily serves construction projects and industrial customers seeking hardware and metal products. The website notes that customers turn to the supplier for construction projects, and the company positions itself as a go-to source for industrial hardware in the Greenwood area.

The company emphasizes its family heritage and the experience of its staff, stating that friendly personnel draw on more than 35 years of industry experience to assist customers. The "Metal is in Our Family" motto reflects the personal commitment behind the operation.
